about_the_game: The production project for "The Prince of Tennis Doki Doki Survival ~eternal passion!" Tie break ♡game—the remastered edition of the romantic adventure game "The Prince of Tennis Doki Doki Survival"—is officially underway!! The Prince of Tennis: Doki Doki Survival – Mystic of the Mountains (released in December 2006) and Secret of the Seaside (released in January 2007) are collectively known by fans as "DokiSaba." In 2011, the series continued with The Prince of Tennis: Gyutto! Doki Doki Survival – Sea and Mountain Love Passion. Now, to celebrate the 20th anniversary of DokiSaba, the beloved romance adventure series is being remastered and will be released on Steam! This beloved romance adventure game lets you enjoy romantic interactions with characters from Prince of Tennis! The remastered edition retains fan-favorite features such as fully voiced scenarios and romanceable characters, while introducing newly drawn still illustrations exclusive to this release. You can choose to view nostalgic stills from the original version or explore newly illustrated scenes in the remastered edition—freely switching between both styles to suit your mood. Stay tuned for upcoming announcements, including the release date, detailed features, and a newly illustrated key visual.

Recommended:
